About the Fixie Friday group ride

Fixed gear only. Meets at Behind Bars in Northeast and does a different thing each week: lake laps, river laps, parking-ramp crits, a costume night. Helmet and lights. Each week's route goes up on the shop's Instagram.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
